component.name: iemod-fetch
component.summary: Choose, download and install Infinity Engine mods

description.p: A wizard for Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition, Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition and EET: it reads the mods you want, downloads and verifies them, orders them by the community's install rules, checks their conflicts and installs them with WeiDU.
This Flatpak is experimental: installing into a game folder chosen through the file portal is not tested yet.
